family: The single total certificate-prefix language specified in proof.md and family.py. For actual length N, choose k0 as the least prime at least the least positive B with B^5>32*N^3, then k as the least prime at least ceil(12*k0/25); read k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, reject invalid Q by the exact Frobenius/gcd test, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding, r=ceil((N-k)/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Output 0 for N=0 or the explicit failed guards in proof.md. The output is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. All k prefix bits are included in N; Q is input, not advice.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P, hence in NP with empty witnesses, and in the full pinned B2 model C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-O(N^(4/5)) for every sufficiently large integer N=|x|. In particular liminf over all integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N is at least 4. For this same fixed family the supplied refined disperser dimension d_new gives certified loss 4*k+8*d_new whose ratio to the supplied former loss 4*k+8*d_old tends to 1/2, with d_new and d_old defined in proof.md. Relative to the supplied reference with degree k0 and its refined dimension, the current complete certified loss has limsup ratio at most 99/100, as proved in proof.md Section 9. For the same current family, the exact sharper d_N in proof.md Section 10 improves the certified lower bound by at least 8*ceil(k*t/(t+1)) gates relative to the supplied preceding dimension d_base=k*t+r*(r+3)/2+1. The threshold-halving statement uses the base dimension as specified in Section 8 and also holds for the sharper loss. The averaged full-hypothesis selection further shows d_N=k*t+r*(r+3)/2-k-t*(t+1)/2+2 eventually, so the exact eventual same-family certified improvement is 8*k+4*t*(t+1)-8 gates, as established in Section 10.1. The finite inert-coordinate ledger in elimination.md Section 3 gives C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(4*k+8*d_N)+4 at every sufficiently large integer N. Thus the exact eventual certified improvement over the supplied base-dimension bound is at least 8*k+4*t*(t+1)-4 gates, as shown in proof.md Section 11.
